Title: AKU-ISMC Alumni Engagement Scheme and Survey
NewsSummary: We are thrilled to announce the launch of our Alumni Engagement Scheme, aimed at fostering lasting connections and meaningful relationships among former students of the MA in Muslim Cultures program and the Dual Degree with Columbia University.
NewsContent:
We are thrilled to announce the launch of our Alumni Engagement Scheme, aimed at fostering lasting connections and meaningful relationships among former students of the MA in Muslim Cultures program and the Dual Degree with Columbia University.

At AKU-ISMC, we understand the value of maintaining ties with our alumni community, and we are dedicated to keeping you involved in the vibrant life of our institute. Whether you graduated recently or years ago, we invite you to participate in our Alumni Engagement Scheme.

How to Get Involved:

Participating in our Alumni Engagement Scheme is simple! All you need to do is complete our Alumni Engagement Survey, where you can share updates on your professional endeavours, personal achievements, and any other exciting developments since your time at AKU-ISMC. Your valuable insights will help us strengthen our alumni network and tailor our programs to better serve your needs.

Access the Survey: To complete the Alumni Engagement Survey, please visit this link. Your input is invaluable to us, and we appreciate you taking the time to share your experiences.

Benefits of Joining:

By joining our Alumni Engagement Scheme, you will have the opportunity to:

Stay Connected: Connect with fellow alumni, faculty, and staff members to nurture lifelong friendships and professional relationships.

Participate in Events: Be the first to know about upcoming events, both virtual and in-person, designed to facilitate networking and collaboration.

Contribute to the Institute: Share your expertise, insights, and experiences to help shape the future of AKU-ISMC and support the next generation of students.

Get Involved Today:

Don't miss out on the chance to be at the heart of our institute! Join our Alumni Engagement Programme and help us create a dynamic and supportive community. Complete the Alumni Engagement Survey today and stay connected with AKU-ISMC.

For former students of AKU-ISMC's MA in Muslim Cultures and students from the Dual Degree with Columbia University, your involvement is invaluable to us. Together, let's continue to make a difference.

For any questions or further information, please don't hesitate to contact us at ismc.alumni2@aku.edu
